chapter: Booker T. Washington Community Center Band
title: Who came to the Kentucky Club get-together
summary: Hoggie (Harold McFerlin), Les Carr, Charlie Bloomer, Isaiah Bland and his twin brother, and Fatha Hines all showed up; they just talked.

bands.name: Booker T. Washington Community Center Band

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Out of the kids band. So these guys, we got together for the club. We had a guy, we called him Hoggie, his name is Harold McFerlin, but Hoggie we called him.
And Les Carr, and Charlie Bloomer was the drummer.
Would that be B-l, double-o, m-e-r?
And we didn't play. We just had a get
At the Celebrity Club. Charlie Bloomer --
I guess some of you hadn't seen each other in a long time.
We hadn't seen each other, you know. And so then we had another guy named Isaiah Bland. He played the alto horn (Singing).
Not the alto sax, but the alto horn.
His name was Isaiah Bland, B-l-a-n-d.
Yeah, like Isaiah. I know he had a brother named Isaac, so I figured Isaiah and Isaac, maybe they named them biblical names.

So he was his twin brother, and both of them played in the band. So he was here, and I hadn't seen him, you know, so that did kind of bring it together, and that night we had a few other guys up there too. Fatha, Fatha Hines. He come by.
